assumptions.description: The explicit reference scenario uses 180 mOhm/square FuseTop; the default nominal dataset retains 500 mOhm/square
assumptions.reason: The low/high values bracket this 180 mOhm/square reference, not the established default estimate derived from the 1/1.5 fF specification

assumptions.description: Apply the selected sheet and per-cut values to unchanged extracted layout geometry
assumptions.reason: The data does not define arbitrary-width corrections, temperature dependence, dimension shifts, statistical coverage or simultaneous manufacturing extrema

assumptions.description: All three scenarios retain nominal empirical capacitance and geometry, with no device-reference dataset or physical-stack match
assumptions.reason: No correlation between these resistance sensitivities, capacitance corners, physical recipes or compact-device corners has been established

assumptions.description: Retain the established P+ salicided Poly2 and wide unsalicided Nwell mapping
assumptions.reason: These are published wide-structure sheet values, applied at fixed drawn dimensions; recognized resistor devices keep their own compact models

assumptions.description: Map the Nwell tap contact to the N+ salicided contact and the MIM top via to Via4; use 5.9 Ohm/cut for the reference Poly2 contact
assumptions.reason: Preserve existing conductor/contact ownership and the corrected poly-contact value rather than the MAGIC nominal 8 Ohm/cut value

assumptions.description: Convert Ohm/square and Ohm/cut to milliohms by multiplying by 1000; retain already-milliohm metal rows
assumptions.reason: FuseTop 0.18 +/- 0.027 Ohm/square gives 153/180/207 mOhm/square; the selected top metal is the 11kA row, not ordinary Metal5
